implemented_requirements.evidence: The file only defines a PUZZLE dict with word coordinate lists; no grid data structure or generation code is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board must be completely filled with letters (no empty cells)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code creates or populates a board; only word coordinate tuples are listed.

implemented_requirements.requirement: No words overlap on the board
implemented_requirements.evidence: There is no validation logic; the coordinate lists even appear to overlap (e.g., (6,2) appears in both EGGS and other words).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Spangram touches two opposite sides of the board
implemented_requirements.evidence: The spangram "BREAKFAST" is listed but no coordinate data or validation is provided to ensure it spans opposite edges.
No UI or rendering code exists; no colour handling is implemented.
No UI or rendering code exists; no colour handling is implemented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Words can be formed by connecting adjacent letters in any direction (including diagonal) and can change direction mid‑word
implemented_requirements.evidence: No path‑finding, adjacency, or direction‑change logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Non‑theme words can be found to earn hints
implemented_requirements.evidence: No mechanism for non‑theme word detection or hint unlocking is implemented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Every 3 non‑theme words unlock a hint
implemented_requirements.evidence: No counting or hint‑trigger logic exists.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Puzzle must be fully completed by finding all theme words and filling the board
implemented_requirements.evidence: No game loop, win‑condition checking, or board‑completion verification is present.

critical_issues: The file contains only a static data dictionary; there is no executable code to generate or display a puzzle.
Missing grid creation, letter placement, and overlap validation.
No UI (Tkinter) implementation despite importing tkinter.
No game logic for word discovery, hint system, or win condition.
Spangram placement and side‑touch validation are absent.
judge.summary: The submitted strands.py file provides only a placeholder data structure with theme, clue, spangram, and hard‑coded word coordinate lists. It lacks any functional implementation of the core NYT Strands puzzle features: grid generation, full board filling, non‑overlapping word placement, spangram side‑to‑side placement, adjacency rules, direction changes, UI rendering, hint mechanics, or completion detection. Consequently, the solution is far from complete and unlikely to be executable as a game.
